content.value: IT center was started by Tanni in a small shopping center, in a first week of operation, she(35) completed the following transactions.

June 4 Purchased supplies for cash Tk. 17,000.
June 5 Received revenue Tk. 8,000 cash for service provided.
June 6 Service provided on account Tk. 7,000.
June 7Paid utility expense Tk. 2,500 in cash.
June 10 Withdraw cash for personal use Tk. 4,000.
